newsitem.title: BURUNDI: Fifteen killed in attack on Burundi camp - radio.
newsitem.headline: Fifteen killed in attack on Burundi camp - radio.

text.p: Five civilians and 10 Hutu rebels were killed during an attack on a camp for displaced people in Burundi's central Muramvya province, state radio said on Sunday.

The radio linked the attack -- in which it said the army clashed with rebels raiding the camp in Bukeye district -- to increased rebel activity in northwest Burundi after attacks on refugee camps in adjoining areas of eastern Zaire.
A Burundian army spokesman confirmed the incident.

Diplomats say they fear that Hutu rebels, pushed out of camps in eastern Zaire because of fighting between the Zairean army and Tutsi rebels, could launch attacks in northwest Burundi as they attempt to cross Burundi to reach Hutu refugee camps in western Tanzania.
The military governor of Cibitoke province, northwest Burundi, was killed with six bodyguards in an ambush last week, in an attack seen as part of the new campaign.

Around 150,000 people have died in Burundi since October 1993 in an ethnic war in which both the Tutsi-dominated army and and Hutu rebels have downplayed their responsibility for attacks on civilians.
